title: Pro2Pro: Focus on Plumbing Episode 1 — Brookline, MA Project (Sewer/Water Main, Drains, and Radiant PEX)

locations.name: Brookline, Massachusetts
locations.basis: Transcript references Brookline and the Thistles project in Brookline

locations.name: Hoboken, New Jersey

summary: This Pro2Pro episode follows host Richard Trathui and plumbing professional Doug Lanzo on a Brookline, MA project to discuss real-world skilled-trades challenges in residential construction. The dialogue tracks a complex sewer and storm main project with subgrade work, including camera inspection that reveals root intrusion and old pipe conditions (clay, Orangeburg, welded or cemented joints), and a plan to open, repair, and re-route around the building. The crew demonstrates trench safety (using trench boxes) and a drainage redesign that adds a perimeter drain and a large dry well to manage rainwater on-site. Interior work highlights space constraints of a mid‑century 1950s building, the integration of Unico high-velocity HVAC with radiant heating using Viega PEX, and venting strategies across jurisdictions. The episode also covers modern PEX connections (ProPress) versus copper, the use of a pneumatic mole to pull pipe, workforce initiatives like Generation Next, and the HomeServe service model, all framed through a live Q&A with industry peers.
